LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 SOCIALISING AND TAKING ACTION: DEBATES AND DISCUSSIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussions, part of Strand 7 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Which skills do we use to debate? 2. How do we use imperative sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. make imperative sentences,

2. watch a debate from a video recording and identify debating skills observed,

3. select a topic based on the theme and debate on it with peers,

4. listen to peers contributing ideas and identify words and phrases used to interrupt, introduce ideas and disagree politely,

5. work jointly to make reviews and summarise ideas for and against the topic of debate. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. make imperative sentences,
2. watch a debate from a video recording and identify debating skills observed,
3. select a topic based on the theme and debate on it with peers,
4. listen to peers contributing ideas and identify words and phrases used to interrupt, introduce ideas and disagree politely,
5. work jointly to make reviews and summarise ideas for and against the topic of debate. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Socialising and Taking Action: Debates and Discussions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self- efficacy: This is developed as the learner shows personal defining skills when contributing their ideas in debates and

discussions.

● Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital content when watching a debate from a video and

identify debating skills.

38

Values:
● Respect: This is cultivated as the learner accommodates the opinion of peers during debates and group discussions.

● Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner diligently takes up various roles during group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Career Education: This is enhanced as the learner debates on topics related to the theme of careers and professions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the debating skills acquired to the learning of concepts in English and Kiswahili.
